m: सरु mfn. (for शरु fr. √ श्री, p. 1056) minute, thin, fine
सरु m. = शरु m. an arrow = त्सरु, the hilt or handle of a sword, L.
a: सरु — a. Thin, fine, small. --रुः The handle of a sword.

m: स—रुधिर—मूत्र mfn. discharging bloody urine (-ता f.), ib.
स—रुच् mfn. possessing splendour splendid, magnificent, Śiś.
सरुद्भव (prob.) w.r. for सराद्भव, a lotus.
स—रुज् mfn. feeling the same pain, Sāh.
स—रुज mfn. having pain, causing it, Car.
suffering pain or sickness, ill, diseased, MBh.; R. &c.
स-रुज-सिद्धाचार्य m. N. of a teacher, Cat.
स—रुष् mfn. angry, enraged, Śiś.; Pañcat.
